notes: Frozen author-upload paper text titles verified against supplied references. Cache encoding uses \ for <, [ for >, 9 for multiplication, and ¼ for =; statistics transcribed with mathematical symbols restored. Original analytic N left null because reported N=27 conflicts with target ANOVA df=30; no sample size derived from df. Replication adds amplitude and omits Impulse. Reported success is the authors’ overall replication verdict about movement performance, not an effect-specific peak-velocity verdict. Condition-by-test is the replication analogue of original Group-by-test; original has three conditions and replication has two.
